body:
One year after the idea first took shape, OneRoadTrip is expanding into two new languages: German and Dutch. 

The website itself is already translated, and the 900+ itineraries are currently being translated. We expect the entire collection to be available in German and Dutch within the next one to two months.

All new itineraries and blog articles are already being published in these languages.

And speaking of the blog, you can now discover six articles about Puglia 🇮🇹 and a new feature on Iceland’s waterfalls 🇮🇸.

Plenty of inspiration for your next adventure — and, as always, everything on OneRoadTrip is completely free. 

==========================================================================

Un an après que l'idée ait germé, OneRoadTrip s'ouvre à de nouvelles langues avec l'Allemand et le Néerlandais. 

Le site est déja traduit et les itinéraires sont en cours de traduction. L'ensemble des 900+ itinéraires devrait être traduit d'ici un à deux mois; 

Les nouveaux itinéraires et articles de blogs sont déjà traduits dans ces langues. 

A ce sujet, vous trouverez dans la partie blog 6 articles sur les Pouilles et un sur les cascades d'Islande.

De quoi donner envie de voyager et le tout est toujours gratuit.

title: Nouvelle fonctionnalité : les boucles journalières /  New feature: daily loops
body:
OneRoadTrip continue d'améliorer l'ergonomie de son application. Jusqu'à présent, un roadtrip était soit linéaire (d'un point A à un point Z), soit en boucle complète (retour au point de départ). Désormais, l'application gère aussi les nuits d'hôtel passées au même endroit. Concrètement, vos boucles journalières apparaissent sur la carte avec des couleurs distinctes. Exemple : vous dormez à Nice, visitez trois villes aux alentours et revenez à Nice, ce tracé s'affiche en bleu. Le lendemain, vous repartez de Nice vers trois nouvelles villes avant d'y revenir dormir, ce second tracé s'affiche en rouge, et ainsi de suite. Cette innovation permet de distinguer d'un coup d'œil chaque journée de visite lorsque vous séjournez plusieurs nuits au même endroit. Et sur vos carnets de voyage, vous pouvez maintenant sélectionner un jour précis sans afficher les autres étapes.

=====================================================================

OneRoadTrip keeps improving the app's user experience. Until now, a road trip was either linear (from point A to point Z) or a full loop (back to the starting point). The app now also handles hotel stays of several nights in the same place. In practice, your daily loops appear on the map in distinct colors. For example: you sleep in Nice, visit three nearby towns and return to Nice, that route shows in blue. The next day, you leave Nice for three new towns before coming back for the night, that second route shows in red, and so on. This makes it easy to tell each sightseeing day apart when you stay several nights in the same place. And in your travel guides, you can now select a specific day without displaying the other stops.

title: partnership with the Diot-Siaci UES / Partenariat avec le CSE Diot-SIaci
body:
We are proud to announce OneRoadTrip's first partnership with the Diot-Siaci UES Works Council (CSE).

CSE beneficiaries will now enjoy free access to more than 900 itineraries across 100 countries. Every itinerary can be fully customized to match each traveler's interests, trip duration and budget.

As France's leading insurance broker, with more than 8,000 employees worldwide, Diot-Siaci becomes OneRoadTrip's first Works Council partner.

This partnership marks an important milestone in the development of our platform and reflects our ambition to make personalized travel planning accessible to everyone.

Many thanks to the Diot-Siaci UES Works Council for their trust.

======================================

Nous sommes fiers d'annoncer le premier partenariat de OneRoadTrip avec le CSE UES Diot-Siaci.

Les bénéficiaires du CSE auront désormais accès gratuitement à plus de 900 itinéraires de road trips couvrant plus de 100 pays. Chaque itinéraire peut être entièrement personnalisé selon les envies, la durée du voyage et le budget de chacun.

En tant que premier courtier français, avec plus de 8 000 collaborateurs à travers le monde, Diot-Siaci devient le premier partenaire CSE de OneRoadTrip.

Cette collaboration marque une étape importante dans le développement de notre plateforme et confirme notre volonté de rendre la préparation de voyages personnalisés accessible au plus grand nombre.

Merci aux équipes du CSE UES Diot-Siaci pour leur confiance.

title: 899 itinéraires - Site opérationnel, prospection lancée / 899 itineraries — platform finalized, prospection launched
body:
OneRoadTrip est désormais considéré comme pratiquement finalisé. Le catalogue s'est enrichi pour atteindre 899 itinéraires, 6,300 lieux répertoriés ainsi que 47 000 visites et activités. L'Europe est désormais presque entièrement couverte. Les utilisateurs peuvent maintenant combiner plusieurs road trips en un seul et unique voyage. Une phase de prospection active a débuté, ciblant les comités d'entreprise, les offices de tourisme, les concepteurs de voyages et les sites web de tourisme établis qui ne disposent pas de la technologie de création d'itinéraires de OneRoadTrip.

OneRoadTrip is now considered virtually finalized. The catalog has grown to 899 itineraries, 6,300 listed places and 47,000 visits and activities. Europe is almost entirely covered. Users can now combine multiple road trips into a single journey. An active prospection phase has begun, targeting works councils, tourism boards, travel planners and established travel websites lacking OneRoadTrip's itinerary-building technology.

title: Featured in Le Blog des Aventuriers
body: Le Blog des Aventuriers, a popular French travel blog created by Florence, now features OneRoadTrip in its selection of the best travel apps. A great recognition from the travel community.

title: 800+ itineraries, 30,000 photos validated
body: OneRoadTrip now offers over 800 itineraries worldwide. All 30,000 place photos have been reviewed and validated. Two new series launched: wine routes across famous wine regions and ghost itineraries exploring legends, witches and haunted places across Europe. Every itinerary now goes through 4 verification phases. On each of the 5,000 destinations, the three best-rated hotels are selected with seasonal pricing. 20 hotel bookings recorded in May alone.

title: InfosTourisme partnership
body: InfosTourisme.com, a leading French B2B tourism media, now features a permanent link to OneRoadTrip in its site navigation. InfosTourisme describes OneRoadTrip as a promising TravelTech start-up built around interactive maps and structured travel data.

title: First press article — InfosTourisme
body: InfosTourisme.com publishes the first press article about OneRoadTrip, highlighting it as a standout European TravelTech project. The article praises the hybrid approach combining AI with human validation, and the platform's catalog of 800+ itineraries across 90+ countries targeting both individual travelers and tourism professionals.

title: First 100 new users in a single day
body: For the first time, OneRoadTrip welcomed over 100 new users in a single day. The platform now counts 730 itineraries, 4,800 listed places and nearly 39,000 detailed visits and activities, all available in 5 languages. The site now totals 160,000 pages. Behind the scenes, 15,000 hotels have been indexed to offer the three best-rated options at each destination.

title: Google page 1 and AI-driven traffic surge
body: Google now ranks OneRoadTrip itineraries on page 1 for many queries. AI assistants like ChatGPT now account for 60% of incoming traffic, having identified OneRoadTrip's thousands of structured data entries as a reliable reference. Traffic doubled in just two days. The platform now attracts over 2,000 unique visitors per month from around the world, with strong return rates.

title: 670 itineraries across 100 countries
body: OneRoadTrip reaches 670 itineraries across 100 countries. 80% have been fully rewritten with a lively, travel-blog tone replacing the earlier encyclopedic style. France, England, Italy and Spain are fully completed. 30,000 photos are under review. The interface has been simplified and every itinerary now passes through a rigorous quality control process. Around 50 visitors per day, 3 months after launch.

title: How OneRoadTrip uses AI — responsibly
body: A behind-the-scenes look at how OneRoadTrip builds its itineraries. AI generates the initial draft based on real web sources, but every itinerary is then reviewed, corrected and validated through multiple passes before publication. AI alone cannot yet produce an error-free itinerary. The combination of AI generation with rigorous human verification is what makes OneRoadTrip content reliable and trustworthy.

title: Carbon score and AI reviews launched
body: Two major features added to OneRoadTrip. Every itinerary now receives a carbon score based on real-time CO2 emissions calculated from actual driving distances and public transport options. Users can also request an instant AI-generated summary and review of any chosen itinerary. France itineraries have been almost entirely rebuilt, Spain is underway.

title: From insurance broker to itinerary builder
body: The story behind OneRoadTrip. Starting mid-August with no coding experience, the founder built a 70,000-file website in 6 languages over 5 months of weekends. Pages reached 12th position on Google just 3 weeks after launch. What started as a personal tool to organize a trip to Sri Lanka has grown into a comprehensive travel planning platform. The journey continues every weekend.

title: OneRoadTrip goes live
body: OneRoadTrip.com is officially online. The platform launches with approximately 500 AI-generated itineraries across 80+ countries in 5 languages. This is just the beginning — the content is functional but will be progressively rewritten and improved to meet higher quality standards.

title: OneRoadTrip beginning
body: Ahead of his upcoming trip to Sri Lanka, Marc SORCI searches online for a simple organizer to replace his Excel spreadsheets, which include daily stages, visits, their duration, travel routes, hotels, and photos. Unable to find a tool offering all of these features, he decides to build his own.
